描述_EN: around 1730 ceramic handles were introduced to europe from china. the object is likely to date from the late sixteenth or early seventeenth century, during elizabeth i's reign. although cutlers were required by their guilds to be able to make a complete knife, handles of carved ivory, silver, bronze and glass were usually imported or made by specialist craftsmen. ebony, ivory, fish skin, tortoiseshell, amber, bone, horn and shell were all popular for decorating cutlery. this knife of ivory with a steel blade damascened in gold and silver, represents a full figure of queen elizabeth i of england holding an orb and a sceptre.
描述_ZN: 大约在1730年，陶瓷手柄从中国传入欧洲。 该物品可能是16世纪末或17世纪初伊丽莎白一世统治时期的产物。 虽然行会要求刀匠能够制作一把完整的刀，但象牙、银、青铜和玻璃雕刻的刀柄通常是进口的或由专业工匠制作。 乌木、象牙、鱼皮、玳瑁、琥珀、骨、角和贝壳都是装饰餐具的常用材料。 这把象牙刀的刀刃是用金银打造的，表现了英国女王伊丽莎白一世的完整形象，手持球状物和权杖。
